Features
Everything you need to practice smarter
BeatCoach combines a precise metronome, flexible song management, audio and sheet music support, and focused exercises — built for musicians who want structure in their rehearsal.
Metronome
Set BPM and start/stop a precise metronome with clear visual feedback.
Customize accents, subdivisions, and note selection for your time feel.
Adjust the volume of individual notes/subdivisions.
Songs & Parts
Organize songs and build them from parts: Phrase, Accelerando, and Ritardando.
Define BPM, time signature, and counts for each part.
Play individual parts or part groups with metronome playback.
Part types: Phrase (steady tempo), Accelerando (gradually faster), and Ritardando (gradually slower).
Each part can have its own BPM, time signature, and counts — with support for up to 40 parts per song.
Audio & Playback
Attach multiple audio tracks to a song and switch between them.
Control playback speed, looping, and jump directly to a part.
Use count-in for audio playback to start in time.
Documents & Sheet Music
Import PDF documents such as sheet music, lead sheets, or lyrics.
Keep everything organized in folders per song.
View PDFs in the app and move files/folders with drag & drop.
Exercises & Progress
Train your inner clock with Silent Beat and Tempo Change exercises.
Repeat whole songs or selected parts with count-in and repetition options.
Increase BPM across part repetitions and track completed passes.
Silent Beat: the metronome mutes by a beat or time pattern. Tempo Change: the tempo changes automatically by your chosen pattern.
Song and Part Repetition: repeat with count-in and repetition options; part repetitions can also change BPM across runs.
MIDI & Settings
Choose between audio and MIDI playback and select a MIDI output device.
Configure count-in and pitch settings for metronome and count-in.
Access tutorials and manage your subscription settings.
Import & Export
Export songs including attachments as a BeatCoach file (.beatcz).
Import songs on another device to keep your material with you.
Ready to practice with BeatCoach?
Download the app and bring structure, timing, and all your song material into one place.

Frequently asked questions
Can I use my own audio files?
Yes. You can attach multiple audio tracks to a song, switch between them, change playback speed, loop sections, and jump to a part.
Can I store sheet music or lyrics?
Yes. You can import PDF documents, organize them in folders per song, view them in the app, and move files with drag & drop.
Does BeatCoach include exercises for timing?
Yes. BeatCoach offers Silent Beat and Tempo Change exercises, plus song and part repetitions with count-in, repetition options, and pass tracking.
Can I use MIDI?
Yes. You can choose MIDI playback and select a MIDI output device in the settings, depending on your setup and app options.
How can I move my songs to another device?
You can export songs, including attachments, as a BeatCoach file (.beatcz) and import them on another device.
